data.title: D · 蜜月晚宴的深红露背礼服
data.description: 执行伪装侦察任务的奢华游轮宴会厅回廊，烛光在水晶壁灯间跳跃。D身穿一袭惊艳的深红丝缎深V露背长礼服，裙裾拖地。精致大腿袜带上隐藏着微型飞刀，白皙如玉的背部线条优雅修长。她挽着手包侧身回眸，红眸中带着特工的敏锐机警，与对心上人毫不保留的信赖依恋。
data.action: standing in gilded palace corridor wearing backless crimson evening gown, turning gracefully with purse, bare shoulders and back glistening in chandelier light, alluring dignified gaze
data.location: gilded ornate ballroom corridor lined with marble columns and crystal chandeliers
data.lighting: dazzling golden chandelier luminescence reflecting off crimson satin
data.mood: glamorous espionage romance, breathtaking aristocratic poise
data.promptProse: Standing in an ornate gilded corridor in a dramatic backless crimson gown, D turns with poised grace. Crystal chandeliers illuminate her bare back and flowing brown hair as her crimson eyes hold a steady, alluring gaze.
data.animaCaption: D standing in an ornate gilded corridor in a backless red evening gown, looking back.
